46: "That swarms upon the earth" - and if it had not informed us that it is the egg of a creeping animal, but rather a non-kosher [animal] generally, I would have said that it is forbidden on account of being from a non-kosher bird, and intend to warn [the potential transgressor not to eat of] a "winged swarming thing" [Deuteronomy 14:19]. Had they warned him [not to eat of] a thing that swarms upon the earth, he would not incur lashes.
